description: The study of noahatfin/telos, adoption decisions, authoring guidance, and evaluation protocol are documented in the repository
rationale: Goals differ (state lives only in the repo; agents own the interaction), so lessons are adopted selectively. The reasoning, including declined features such as syncing constraints into instruction files, must be reviewable and revisitable.
requirements: Each Telos lesson states its evidence and whether it was adopted, adapted, audited, or declined, with reasons
Divergences from Telos (single-sourced state, no export into instruction files) are stated explicitly
No claim that intent improves agent behavior is made without results from the documented evaluation protocol
title: Telos lessons recorded with evidence and divergences
